name: my-thesis-project
description: This project is a VS Code extension that provides AI-generated code review suggestions for F# and WebSharper code. It analyzes selected code and suggests improvements in readability, performance, and maintainability using a locally hosted LLM.

scripts.rag:copy: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'); const src='rag-artifacts'; const dst='extension/ai-code-review/resources/rag-artifacts'; fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); for (const f of ['kb.index','metadata.json']) fs.copyFileSync(p.join(src,f), p.join(dst,f));"
scripts.rag:build: npm run rag:prepare && npm run rag:copy
